description: A black perforated metal base plate sits on the table with an upright black bracket that has a large circular cutout, and an L‑shaped Allen key lies in front of it. The right hand reaches in, picks up the Allen key, inserts its short end into a socket screw on the upright bracket, and twists the key back and forth to loosen/tighten the fixture, briefly repositioning the key and trying another screw before pulling the key away; the left hand stays resting near the front and does not touch the parts.
